title: This Animal's 18-Inch Tongue Licks Its Own Eyeballs

scenes.text: This animal licks its own eyeballs.
It's the okapi, and its tongue is up to 18 inches long.
That's long enough to clean its own ears and eyelids.
It also wraps the purple tongue around leaves to pull them in.
Okapis look like zebras, but they're the only living relative of the giraffe.
Scientists didn't name the species until 1901. Now you know why it licks its eyes.

description:
